note: The workflow changes approved for the historical-data handoff. Read by guard_update_yml.py (Python guards) and tests/approved_workflows.js (JavaScript guards). update.yml must differ from the commit by EXACTLY these added lines (an empty difference is fine once they are committed); the two historical workflows must be byte-for-byte the pinned versions. Any other edit to these files, or any edit to another workflow, still trips the protected-file guards. Changing them again means updating this file on purpose.

added_lines: # the saved daily prices (written to the data branch by "Save historical price data"); they replace any copy that came from the saved-data cache

if ls ledger-branch/historical/shards/*.json >/dev/null 2>&1; then mkdir -p _site/out/by_symbol/historical; cp ledger-branch/historical/shards/*.json _site/out/by_symbol/historical/; fi
